create_ImageList_from_tensors: create an ImageList from a list of torch tensors with optional padding and size divisibility
access_ImageList_by_index: access an individual image from an ImageList by index to get its original unpadded tensor
convert_ImageList_device: convert an ImageList tensor to a different device using the to method
get_ImageList_length: get the number of images in an ImageList using the len function
inspect_ImageList_device_property: inspect the device property of an ImageList to check which device its tensor resides on
